name: USAA Eagle Adapt Visa

apr.notes: The APR applies to purchases, balance transfers and cash advances. 0% intro APR through the May 2028 billing cycle on purchases, and on balance transfers and convenience checks that post by January 31, 2027. Convenience check fee is also 5%. Balance transfer and cash advance fee is 5% of each transaction amount (cash advance fee waived for electronic transfers to a USAA Bank deposit account). No penalty APR. Late and returned payment fees up to $35.

credit_required.notes: USAA membership is required to apply.

categories.label: Eligible spend categories (including groceries, dining, home improvement and more)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire. Redeem through options including Cash Rewards (1 point = $0.01) and Shop with Rewards (1 point = $0.008).

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $200 bonus after spending $1,000 on qualifying purchases by January 31, 2027.

notes: Launched in July 2026. The 3% rate applies to the first $3,000 in combined quarterly purchases across eligible spend categories; USAA lists groceries, dining and home improvement among them, and the full category list is not on the public page text. Rewards are earned as points at 1 point per $1. The disclosures name it the Eagle Adapt Visa Credit Card and do not state a Visa Signature or Platinum tier.
